Voter Guide

Jessica Arriaga (Example Party)

Occupation / Current Position: Member of Congress

Education: Example State University

What are your top priorities if elected?

I will introduce legislation to cap insulin co-pays at $35 per month for every insured patient, not only for seniors. I will vote against any budget that cuts the rural hospital grant program.

How would you address the cost of housing?

I will sponsor a bill to fund 40,000 new affordable housing units in the first two years, and I will oppose any measure that lets out-of-state investors buy single-family homes in bulk.

What areas of public policy are you personally passionate about?

Working families deserve a fair shot. Our district has been left behind for too long, and together we can build something better.

Responses are published as submitted by the candidate.
